title: Cleaner entry reproduces the bank frame
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Boolean Turing machine, let $\mathit{emit}\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, and let $x,\mathit{arg},\mathit{cap}$ be Boolean words. For any time $T$ and source tape $i$, embedding the cleaner's entry configuration for tape $i$—with that tape's data, visited-span marker, origin marker, and head position taken from the run of $M$ on $\mathit{arg}$ at time $T$—into the three slots for tape $i$ in the bank frame with the first $i$ banks blank gives exactly that bank frame, with the cleaner in state $0$ for tape $i$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean input, argument, and capture words $x,\mathit{arg},\mathit{cap}$
replaced:
For every mode, input, argument and capture words, time $T$, and source tape $i$:
relocating the interval cleaner's entry configuration for bank $i$ (actual data, visited
span, origin marker, actual head) into the cleanup frame whose first $i$ banks are blank
yields exactly that frame, with every other bank and both administrative tapes retained.
